name: Book of Vile Darkness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

powers.name: Study it (80 hours)
powers.text: Spend 80 hours reading it: a score rises by 2 (to 24) and another falls by 2; you'll never be rid of its taint.

summary: The ultimate treatise on evil: study it to raise one ability by 2 at the cost of another, and gain a dark taint.
text: Those in thrall to evil feast on the contents of this vile manuscript of unspeakable wickedness. A creature attuned to it must spend 80 hours studying its pages; after that, one of its ability scores goes up by 2 (maximum 24) and another of its choosing goes down by 2. When found, the book is given one major and one minor beneficial property plus one major and one minor detrimental property. A creature that isn't evil takes 6d6 Psychic damage upon attuning to it, and for as long as it stays attuned, the end of every Long Rest brings it one level of Exhaustion.
